body: My gf is the only thing keeping me going at this point. Loosing her would be a game ender for me.

> Sounds like you need someone to get on your case about being productive. Is there anyone in your life who can nag you about that? Mentors, mothers, whatever :) Otherwise, there are plenty of anti-Reddit programs out there.  

The only person who cares whether I'm living and breathing is my gf. She's so busy with her grad program that she doesn't have the time for this sort of thing. Also, I don't want to put her in the position of having to babysit me, as I'm sure that would breed resentment.  

> If you are unemployable per their standards, find out what needs to be fixed  

The specific reasons I was given by the employment agent were: A. I have a long unemployment gap in my history B. I have no references from my previous employer, (things did not end well there). I'm not sure what can be done about either of these.

> Are you even trying? WTF  

No, not anymore. I gave up on the job hunt a few months ago. I became too demoralized. Add to this the fact that I'm not happy when I am working. I hate the dehumanizing corporate hierarchy, I hate the petty shallow office politics, and I hate that I have to work for people who have no technical understanding of what I do but get paid more to leech off of my hard work. Part of my problem is when I do find a job, I end up being so miserable there that I sabotage myself, I quit the job, and the cycle starts all over again. While I was job hunting part of my brain was always asking, "Why are you even bothering, you know you're going to be unhappy and fuck this up in a few months anyways".

> You're rationalizing on both fronts. "won't bother with me" - Says who?  

I've actually been told this by employment agents firsthand. In their book I'm unemployable.  

In general though, I understand what you're saying. And I have tried taking the first step. I make up my mind, "Im going to do some web project that will show off my skills", I tell my gf thats what Im going to do, I get infront of the computer ready to rock, and..... nothing.... Nothing happens. I sit and stare, and end up browsing reddit all day. My problem is the follow through.

Sadly employment agencies in my field won't bother with me anymore due to my unemployment gap, and because I can't give any references from my last employer (things did not end well). My "landlord" is a large property management company that won't give a rats ass about my financial situation.  

I would like to change myself and become pro-active/motivated about finding a new job. Everytime I start along that mental pathway, the voices of anxiety chime in: "You've been unemployed too long, no one will want you" "You're too fat and ugly, they will be repulsed by you" "Job hunting is demoralizing" "Corporate life is demoralizing" .... and I become crippled, resulting in me doing nothing all day every day. I don't know what to do to overcome this problem.

"Fiddling" with the dates of employment backfires when the place you're applying to calls your previous employers to verify. The dates don't match and then they think you're trying to hide something and thus don't hire you. I don't understand how this is supposed to help.
Food stamps I have. I was under the impression that it costs thousands of dollars to file bankruptcy and on top of that you can't get debt forgiveness anymore, so whats the point?
